data.title: Keitaro/Binom TDS Abuse Infrastructure Detection
data.description: Detect abuse of legitimate Traffic Distribution Systems Keitaro and Binom for fraud infrastructure: (1) HTTP redirect chains containing Keitaro tracking parameters such as click_id, campaign_id, and characteristic Keitaro URL path structures, (2) domains resolving to IP addresses associated with Keitaro or Binom hosting infrastructure, (3) redirect chain behavior patterns matching cloaking and visitor fingerprinting techniques used to evade security researchers while directing victims to investment scam landing pages.

enrichment_required.source: Web proxy enrichment (TDS redirect pattern fingerprinting)
WHOIS enrichment (domain registration age for final redirect destination)

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Keitaro/Binom TDS Abuse Infrastructure Detection")`
`comment("HTTP redirect chain analysis for TDS abuse patterns")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:http_log
(url_query="*click_id=*" OR url_query="*campaign_id=*" OR url_query="*keitaro*" OR url_query="*binom*" OR url_query="*cnv_id=*")
OR (url_path="*/tracker/*" OR url_path="*/click/*" OR url_path="*/go/*" OR url_path="*/click.php*")
| transaction session_id maxspan=30s
| where eventcount>=3
| eval redirect_chain=mvjoin(url, " -> ")
| eval has_keitaro=if(like(url_query, "%keitaro%") OR like(url_path, "%/tracker/%"), 1, 0)
| eval has_binom=if(like(url_query, "%binom%") OR like(url_path, "%/click.php%"), 1, 0)
| where has_keitaro=1 OR has_binom=1
| stats count values(redirect_chain) as chains values(final_destination) as destinations by src_ip session_id

falsepositives: Legitimate digital marketing campaigns using Keitaro or Binom for affiliate analytics
Performance marketing redirect chains for authorized advertising
